committee.sub: Morning brief · Sunday 1 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: The landing-page test has now logged 75 raw paid clicks and spend of $507.80 ex GST, while weekly ad spend rose to $141.36 from $122.11 even though clicks held flat at 17 versus 18 and conversions stayed at zero.

Rank lost impression share sits far above budget lost (77.2 versus 15.8) with impression share at only 10%, so the ceiling right now is ad rank, not budget; no outside account edits were logged in the last 7 or 24 hours, so this reading is clean.

Of the 75 raw clicks on the test, 17 triggered the ask_cta_click (the short question form), with zero review_cta_click bookings; the page has been frozen since click 25 so this split reflects the locked copy and layout.

Organic Search sessions more than doubled (11 versus 5 prior), the only unpaid signal worth trusting, while AI Assistant sessions fell to 0 from 2 and the chatgpt.com referral disappeared from source/medium; Search Console (data through 29 Oct, so it lags) shows just 5 clicks on 190 impressions over 8 days, with 'kontrol' and 'kontrol ai' among top queries.

actions.text: Chris: raw paid clicks on the landing-page test have reached 75 with eventsSinceStart.generate_lead still at zero; check the test log now, if relevant clicks are 75+ with zero qualified enquiries the red flag is live and needs a decision before more spend goes out.
Open item: logo and image assets are still needed for the serving ad groups (Agency, Job Intake).
Open item: RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success and need updating to match current site stats.
